maria_cs: Heads up — SparkPay renewal coming up. Customer asked for a 24m term (was 12m) and is requesting ~10% off list. Procurement says they need an updated SOW + PO flow before signatures. We have ~$120k ARR today. Can we move on pricing and timeline? Link to current contract: https://redwood.app/contracts/SPARKPAY-2024
jon_ae: ping @priya_finops @evan_legal. Quick Q: is a 10% discount on a longer term something finance can approve or do we need manager sign-off? Also confirm whether we can keep current onboarding credits.
priya_finops: 10% across-the-board needs approval from finance lead. If they stretch to 24m we can structure as: year1 billed upfront, year2 billed at renewal with price protection. Need committed ARR number and billing profile. Who owns PO intake?
ev an_legal: evan_legal: want to review SOW changes — term extension, data residency language unchanged, but need to confirm indemnity limits if term doubles. Send redlines once you have draft SOW.
sachin_csm: I can own updated SOW draft — will include "implementation milestones" and keep same onboarding credits (we offered $10k onboarding credit this year). Customer expects signature by 2026-05-15 to hit their procurement cycle.
maria_cs: here's a quick draft quote for visibility:
```
Product: Redwood Hosted API
Term: 24 months
List price (annual): $120,000
Discount: 10% (applied to list)
Billing: Year1 upfront, Year2 invoice
Net total: $216,000
Notes: $10k onboarding credit applied in year1
```
jon_ae: that math looks right. If finance needs manager OK, I'll escalate. Also, procurement asked for our payment terms (NET45 vs NET30). Can we do NET45 for this customer?
priya_finops: NET45 is acceptable for customers of this profile — require credit review. I'll run the credit check today and post results. If credit is clean, finance can approve NET45 and sign-off on structured billing.
evan_legal: Received. Once sachin posts the SOW + redlines I'll review. One ask: include clause for automatic fallback to existing SLA if we change deployment. keep termination notice at 60 days for material breach.
sachin_csm: dropping SOW link in channel in a few. Also note: customer wants to add an additional seat for support in year2 — that's a change order, we'll quote after signature.
